groups.defect: EmbeddableHost before_validation calls self.host.sub! with no nil guard, so a nil host raises NoMethodError instead of failing validation.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same callback lines and report the same nil dereference.

groups.defect: update/destroy dereference a nil host when the id is not found, causing a 500 instead of a 404; also, a missing params[:embeddable_host] is dereferenced in save_host.
groups.rationale: All report the same missing nil check after the lookup in update/destroy. s_b171a9e5 also reports the missing params check.

groups.defect: The migration indexes execute(...)[0] without checking for an empty result, so it crashes; it also interpolates the host value directly into the INSERT SQL, so a quote breaks it or allows SQL injection.
groups.rationale: s_74124a9e reports both the [0] crash (shared with s_9d76f63a and s_7cfecf36) and the SQL interpolation (shared with s_5ffb9255), which links all four in a chain.

groups.defect: The migration inserts raw host values with scheme/path, but the model normalizes and looks up bare hosts, so migrated hosts never match.
groups.rationale: All three report the same normalization mismatch in the migration INSERT loop. The SQL escaping appears only in their proposed fixes.

groups.defect: The contents of category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb are swapped, so each file defines the other's fabricator.
groups.rationale: These describe the same file-swap defect from each of the two files. One swap fixes both.
